UPDATE child_session cs SET status = 'CLOSED', ended_at = COALESCE(cs.last_activity_at, now()), duration_seconds = GREATEST(0, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(cs.last_activity_at, now()) - cs.started_at))::int) WHERE cs.status = 'ACTIVE' AND cs.id NOT IN ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (child_profile_id) id FROM child_session WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY child_profile_id, started_at DESC );
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_child_session_active_per_child ON child_session (child_profile_id) WHERE status = 'ACTIVE';
